snippet.title: THE DEMO IS RELEASED!!! - Doodle Dice Monsters Announcement
snippet.description:
Wishlist Doodle Dice Monsters on Steam today, and play the Demo! https://store.steampowered.com/app/2454170/Doodle_Dice_Monsters/

DDM is a fast and strategic turn-based game where you get to draw your own characters! Form your six character dream team, then fight in tag-team combat in either multi-player or single-player mode: the winner not only gets epic loot, but gets to take one of the defeated Doodlemon for their own!

Join the discord to get the latest updates and discuss the game/give feedback!
https://discord.gg/CN5kkCJxSZ
